title: Staff Software Engineer
description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do As a Staff Software Engineer in the Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) team, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and delivering highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native data protection solutions. This is a deeply hands-on role for an engineer who combines strong architectural and engineering depth, practical AI expertise, and an aggressive delivery mindset . You will be expected not only to solve complex technical problems, but also to drive solutions from ambiguity to production with speed, ownership, and engineering excellence. Your responsibilities will include: Own architecture and technical direction for complex capabilities within the EDP platform, translating product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions. Drive complex initiatives end-to-end , from technical exploration and architecture through implementation, testing, rollout, operationalisation, and production stabilisation. Design and build highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems and microservices using Java and modern cloud-native technologies . Provide technical leadership for EDP capabilities spanning AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), hybrid, and on-premises environments . Apply strong distributed-systems fundamentals to challenges involving data protection, backup and restore, large-scale data movement, orchestration, resiliency, security, and failure recovery. Bring practical AI expertise to engineering. Identify opportunities to use AI, generative AI, agents, and AI-assisted development to accelerate software engineering, improve product capabilities, automate operational workflows, and increase developer productivity. Rapidly prototype and validate AI-driven solutions, and convert successful experiments into secure, reliable, production-quality capabilities. Promote effective use of AI-assisted software development across design, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting while maintaining appropriate engineering judgement and quality controls. Demonstrate an aggressive delivery mindset by breaking large problems into incremental outcomes, removing technical blockers, making pragmatic decisions, and maintaining strong execution momentum without compromising critical quality, security, or reliability requirements. Make thoughtful technical trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, maintainability, operational complexity, and business impact. Establish and raise engineering standards around architecture, coding, APIs, observability, testing, security, performance, deployment, and operational readiness. Lead technical design and code reviews and actively contribute production-quality code for critical components. Diagnose complex production and distributed-system issues across application, infrastructure, database, networking, and cloud layers. Identify architectural and technical debt proactively and drive improvements that simplify the platform and increase engineering velocity.
